_readme: Golden set for the voice-RFQ parser (lib/voice/parser.ts). `utterance` is what the parser receives (post-Sarvam English / code-mixed). `expect.specialization` may be an array when several vocabulary values are legitimately correct. Vague cases MUST come back uncertain=true with category null — a wrong guess is a failure, per the Phase 8b spec. Run: pnpm --filter @amclub/web eval:golden

cases.note: Regression guard: 'factory' must not pull this into government-licensing, and Hyderabad must map to TS.
